pairs.question: Quis rubor iste poli? quod tam lugubre refulsit sidus?
pairs.answer: Ipsius en oculos et lumina torva draconis aspicis.
pairs.derivation: Jason, seeing the sudden flame and gleaming darkness, asks 'quis rubor iste poli? quod tam lugubre refulsit sidus?' (lines 58-60). The intervening speech tag 'ait, reddit trepido cui talia virgo:' is framing/narration and is dropped. Medea answers directly: the answer window ends at the first full stop ('aspicis.'); what follows ('ille suis haec vibrat fulgura cristis...') elaborates on the dragon and is cut. The dangling every-5-lines verse number 60 was stripped.
